content: Universities now grapple with AI writing tools as they once did with ghostwriting. In 2023, Vanderbilt University apologized after using ChatGPT for a condolence email, revealing persistent discomfort: even disclosed assistance feels deceptive. Ghostwriting has existed for centuries among elites, yet always carried moral ambiguity despite being contractual. Current campus policies permit AI for editing but prohibit submitting generated content as original. Rules can ensure compliance, but public expectation remains unchanged—readers want authentic expression from named authors.

title: 9块9充话费，为什么突然消失了？
content: China's telecom operators have stopped third-party platforms from selling low-cost recharge options and cheap data SIM cards. Previously, users could recharge phone credit in small amounts (10-20 yuan) via WeChat or Alipay, and buy discounted data plans through e-commerce platforms. These options are now restricted to official operator apps, with minimum recharges starting at 50 yuan. While operators cite security concerns and expired contracts as reasons, deeper factors include market saturation, declining traditional revenue, and strategic shifts toward AI and computing services. Users face higher costs and fewer flexible options, though official channels offer more security. Consumer demand for affordable, convenient services persists unmet.

title: 闲来一坐s话投资：从“业余小散”到“慢慢变富”流派布道者
content: "闲来一坐s话投资" is a prominent Chinese retail value investor who advocates the "get rich slowly" philosophy. His core framework treats stock ownership as equity in businesses rather than trading chips, using "five quality standards" and "nine selection tools" to identify superior companies with economic moats. Key principles include buying during bear markets or temporary setbacks, holding long-term through dividends and share accumulation, and following ten discipline rules—such as ignoring macro predictions and market noise. His daughter's portfolio grew from 500,000 to 2.91 million yuan over eleven years (17%+ annualized) without additional deposits, demonstrating compound growth through dividend reinvestment. In 2024, he evolved toward a "high quality plus high dividend" strategy focusing on companies with ROE above 15% and 3-5% yield, prioritizing simplicity and defensiveness for ordinary investors.

title: 性格也能“逆天改命”：别用意志力硬扛，靠这套动作骗过你的大脑
content: Personality is not fixed but a dynamic feedback loop shaped by neural circuits, behaviors, and experiences. Genes provide a baseline, but environment and repeated actions sculpt traits through epigenetics and neuroplasticity. Key mechanisms include dopamine-driven reward sensitivity (extroversion) and threat-detection systems (neuroticism). The brain constructs self-schemas that become self-fulfilling prophecies. Since behavior is the only consciously controllable element in this loop, deliberately acting like one's desired self—despite discomfort—provides evidence that forces the brain to update its model. Meaningful change requires persistent action over time; there are no shortcuts.
